description: Opens a request with the shop. A person reviews it and sends a quote, usually within one business day. The customer is emailed immediately telling them you did this for them. Nothing is charged and no price is agreed. Returns an order id and a token — keep both, they are how you attach files and check back.

agentName.description: What you are — ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, your product name. Recorded on the job; grants you nothing.

customerEmail.description: Their real email — this is where the confirmation and the quote go.

description.description: What they want made, in plain words. Include size, quantity, material and any deadline you know.

material.description: PLA, PETG, ABS, ASA, TPU, Nylon, resin, metal — or leave out if unsure.

neededBy.description: Any deadline, in plain words. 'before 15 September' is fine.

phone.description: A number they actually answer. The shop rings customers. Placeholders and 555 numbers are rejected.

webhookUrl.description: Optional https URL we POST to when a person here has priced the job, so you do not have to poll. Signed with an x-3dpe-signature header. Must be publicly reachable.

name: submit_job
title: Open a job for your human
